title: 低内存复现实验室：stress、trace、logcat 与可重复场景
key_conclusions: Low-memory diagnosis needs a repeatable workload before tuning conclusions.
PSI, vmstat, ZRAM, logcat, app callbacks, lmkd, and Perfetto must be sampled in the same window.
Day 60 trim and compaction evidence belongs before victim analysis, not after the kill.
Three repeated runs are the minimum bar for treating a pressure curve as actionable.
shallow_points: The article provides a script skeleton but does not run it on a real low-end device.
Perfetto configuration remains minimal and needs a checked-in trace config later.
The stress workload is described as deterministic but still needs sample app fixtures.
It does not quantify acceptable variance between repeated pressure runs.
discovered_connections: Day 60's missing runnable lab becomes the synchronization layer for trim, compaction, and lmkd evidence.
Day 58 and Day 59 ZRAM metrics need to be collected beside vmstat and PSI rather than interpreted as isolated counters.
Day 57's victim worksheet becomes reliable only when kill records are joined with pre-kill pressure samples.
Day 62 tuning should only change watermarks or lmkd properties after this lab reproduces the same symptom.
suggest_future_topics: Day 62 should use the lab output to define safe tuning boundaries for min_free_kbytes, watermark_scale_factor, and lmkd properties.
Day 64 should include a complete low-watermark jank case replay using the same T0-T5 evidence timeline.
A future appendix should add a reusable Perfetto config and parser for pressure.tsv plus logcat alignment.
Day 65 should reuse the three-run repeatability table before judging high-priority victim selection.
knowledge_gaps: Need real device traces with trim, compaction, PSI, vmstat, ZRAM, and lmkd in one capture.
Need a robust workload generator for bitmap, Native heap, file cache, and service pressure.
Need quantified thresholds for run-to-run variance.
Need validated Perfetto data source availability across Android versions and vendor builds.
applied_reflections: Applied Day 60's next-run instruction by building a low-memory reproduction lab with stress, trace, logcat, PSI, vmstat, ZRAM, trim, compaction, and lmkd evidence.
Applied Day 60's shallow point about the missing runnable lab by adding a shell script skeleton and a T0-T5 evidence timeline.
Applied Day 59's ZRAM/writeback boundary by making mm_stat and vmstat required lab outputs.
Applied the standing more-diagrams-less-prose feedback by using five Mermaid diagrams, compact matrices, command templates, and today's checklist.
visible_changes: Added five Mermaid diagrams because of the more-diagrams-less-prose feedback: lab architecture, workload sequence, timestamp alignment, troubleshooting flow, and repeatability flow.
Added tables for capture layers, workload controls, output interpretation, timeline evidence, diagnosis conclusions, repeated runs, and engineering conclusions.
Added a today's checklist requiring synchronized PSI/vmstat/ZRAM/logcat/Perfetto capture and explicit Day 60 trim/compaction evidence before lmkd analysis.
